title: Private NAS DR binding: the one place a literal destination path may live
description: Lives on the protected control root, never in the public tree and never inside a preflight packet. The pure judge never reads this file; a reader derives refs and digests from it. Native SMB only: a RaiDrive host or a drive-letter destination fails the pattern instead of being normalized away.

credentialTargetRef.description: A Windows protected-storage target NAME, never a credential value. The required dotted namespace is what makes that structural: a bare token or key shape has no dot and cannot match. A password, token or key must never appear in this file.

unc_share.description: Exactly two backslashes, one host, one share, and nothing after it. A drive letter, a device or extended-length prefix, an admin share, a trailing separator and any deeper path all fail: lane segments come from namespaces, never from this string. The host must not contain 'raidrive' in any case or position. That name screen is a naming-convention SCREEN, not a provider guarantee: a RaiDrive virtual host can be given any name, so only the runtime provider_check below can decide that a mount is really native SMB.

provider_check.description: The runtime gate that actually decides native SMB. A name pattern cannot: this must be measured against the live mount provider before any write, and it is not satisfied by this file existing.
